statBlock.name: Fire Giant Dreadnought
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: Fire giant foundries put their strongest workers to use moving coal and ore. In battle, a dreadnought fills its two spiked shields with hot coals and drives forward behind them.

sections.Traits: Dual Shields. The pair grants a total +3 bonus to AC, already included in the giant's AC.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Fireshield and Rock.
Fireshield. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (4d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage, 7 (2d6) fire damage, and 7 (2d6) piercing damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +13 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.
Shield Charge (Recharge 5–6). Move up to 30 ft. in a straight line. The giant can pass through the spaces of creatures smaller than Huge. The first time it enters each creature's space during the move, that creature makes a DC 21 Strength save. On a failure, the creature takes 36 (8d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and 14 (4d6) fire damage, is pushed up to 30 ft., and falls prone.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 124.

statBlock.name: Firenewt Warlock of Imix
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: Warlocks of Imix lead firenewt theocracies or advise their high priests. They revere fire for its power to destroy.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The warlock breathes air and water.
Devil's Sight. Its darkvision works in magical darkness.
Imix's Blessing. When the warlock drops an enemy to 0 hit points, it gains 5 temporary hit points.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Morningstar and Fire Ray.
Morningstar. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
Fire Ray. Ranged spell attack, +4 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) fire damage.
sections.Spellcasting: As an action, cast one of these spells at will using Charisma (spell save DC 12). Guidance, Light, Mage Armor, Mage Hand, or Prestidigitation.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 125.

statBlock.name: Firenewt Warrior
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: Firenewt warriors live near sources of moist heat. Many feed and shelter giant striders, which willingly carry them into battle.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The warrior breathes air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Scimitar attacks.
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.
Spit Fire (Recharges after a short or long rest). Target one creature within 10 ft. It makes a DC 11 Dexterity save, taking 9 (2d8) fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 125.

statBlock.name: Flail Snail
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: An earth elemental with club-tipped tentacles and a colorful shell. The mineral trail it leaves hardens into glass thin enough to cut into window panes.

sections.Traits: Antimagic Shell. The snail has advantage on saves against spells, and spell attacks against it have disadvantage. If the snail saves successfully against a spell of 1st level or higher or that spell's attack misses it, its shell releases stored force. Every creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 3 (1d6) force damage per spell level on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make five Flail Tentacle attacks.
Flail Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Scintillating Shell (Recharges after a short or long rest). The shell casts bright light for 30 ft. and dim light for another 30 ft. through the end of the snail's next turn. While the light lasts, creatures that can see the snail have disadvantage on attacks against it. When the light first appears, each creature in the bright area that can see the snail must pass a DC 15 Wisdom save or remain stunned until the light ends.
Shell Defense. The snail retreats into its shell. It gains +4 AC and is restrained until it emerges.
sections.Bonus actions: Emerge. On its turn, the snail can leave its shell to end Shell Defense.
sections.Using the shell: An intact shell weighs about 250 pounds and can sell for 5,000 gp. A skilled armorer can cut it into three shields. For 1 month, each shield grants its wielder Antimagic Shell. A shield whose magic has faded can form the base for a Spellguard Shield. Ground shell can also go into the dye and serve as a ritual component for a Robe of Scintillating Colors.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 126.

statBlock.name: Flind
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: Yeenoghu transforms especially vicious gnolls into flinds. A flind leads its war band's charge with a flail that disorients, hurts, or paralyzes its targets.

sections.Traits: Aura of Blood Thirst. A creature within 10 ft. of the flind that has the Rampage trait can make a Bite attack as a bonus action. This aura is inactive while the flind is incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Flail of Chaos, one Flail of Pain, and one Flail of Paralysis attack, or make three Longbow attacks.
Flail of Chaos. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. On a failed DC 16 Wisdom save, the target must use its reaction, if available, to make one melee attack against a randomly chosen creature other than the flind within reach. If there is no such creature, it moves half its speed in a random direction instead.
Flail of Pain. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage and 16 (3d10) psychic damage.
Flail of Paralysis. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. On a failed DC 16 Constitution save, the target is paralyzed until the end of its next turn.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 127.

statBlock.name: Fraz-Urb’luu
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: The Prince of Deception recruits mortals under false identities. He sends his servants to find the scattered pieces of the staff taken from him during his imprisonment beneath Castle Greyhawk.

sections.Damage immunities: Poison. Nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). After failing a save, Fraz-Urb’luu can spend one use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. He has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Undetectable. Divination magic cannot target him. Magical scrying sensors cannot perceive him, and abilities that sense demons or fiends cannot detect him.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Fist attacks, and use Phantasmal Terror.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d6 + 9) force damage.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (3d8 + 9) force damage.
Phantasmal Terror. Choose one visible creature within 120 ft. On a failed DC 23 Wisdom save, it takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage and is frightened of Fraz-Urb’luu until the end of its next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 23). No material components are required.
At will. Alter Self, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, and Phantasmal Force. Alter Self can make him Medium when he uses its appearance option.
3/day each. Mislead, Programmed Illusion, and Seeming.
1/day each. Modify Memory and Project Image.
sections.Legendary actions:
Fraz-Urb’luu has 3 legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of his turn. He can choose one option immediately after another creature finishes its turn. He loses access to these actions while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, he must finish his first turn before using one.
Tail (1 action). Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (2d10 + 9) force damage. A Large or smaller creature is also grappled (escape DC 24) and remains restrained for the duration of the grapple. His tail can grapple only one creature at a time.
Terror (2 actions). Use Phantasmal Terror.
sections.Lair: Fraz-Urb’luu lairs in the fortress city of Zoragmelok in Hollow’s Heart. In his lair he is CR 24 (62,000 XP).
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, after anyone tied at 20, choose one action while Fraz-Urb’luu is in his lair. He cannot repeat an option in consecutive rounds. He must be able to act and, if surprised, must finish his first turn before using a lair action.
Conjure Walls and Doors. Turn up to five doors in the lair into walls and open an equal number of new doors in walls that had none.
Psychic Anguish. Every creature he can see in the lair makes a DC 23 Wisdom save, taking 33 (6d10) psychic damage on a failure.
Simulacrum. Pick one humanoid in the lair and instantly make a duplicate as with the Simulacrum spell. The duplicate obeys him and is destroyed at the next initiative count 20.
sections.Regional effects:
Choose one or more of these effects for the area surrounding the lair.
Beguiling Realm. Within 6 miles, Charisma (Persuasion) and Wisdom (Insight) checks have disadvantage. Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Performance) checks have advantage.
Nostalgic Pangs. Within 1 mile, sapient creatures often catch brief glimpses of long-dead friends or companions.
Twisted Paths. Within 6 miles, roads and trails bend back on themselves and make navigation difficult.
If Fraz-Urb’luu dies, the effects fade over 1d10 days.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 129.

statBlock.name: Froghemoth
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: This amphibious predator hides in murky pools with only its three-eyed stalk showing. Bullywugs sometimes feed and shelter one as a god.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The froghemoth breathes air and water.
Shock Susceptibility. When it takes lightning damage, its speed is halved and it has disadvantage on Dexterity saves until the end of its next turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks. The froghemoth can also use Tongue.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage and swallows a Medium or smaller creature. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects from outside the froghemoth, and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the froghemoth's turns. Its gullet holds up to two creatures.
If one creature inside deals 20 damage or more to the froghemoth in a single turn, the froghemoth makes a DC 20 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On a failure, it regurgitates every swallowed creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 ft. If the froghemoth dies, the creatures are no longer restrained and can spend 10 ft. of movement to escape its corpse. Each falls prone on exit.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and grapples a Huge or smaller creature (escape DC 16). The froghemoth has four tentacles. A tentacle that has a creature grappled cannot target another creature.
Tongue. Target one visible Medium or smaller creature within 20 ft. On a failed DC 18 Strength save, pull it to an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the froghemoth.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 130.
